- Kimberly (partner ops) will advise on the co-sell eligibility and AWS prerequisites.
- Karthik (solutions) will schedule a quick technical scoping call to validate network/SCIM/KMS constraints.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the DocuSign/PO timeline? If procurement can share a target date I will map to our prelisting checklist.

I'll attach the ACE registration template and a draft Mutual Action Plan — can you and Aria take a look and propose edits?

Best,

Thanks, Olga & Ravi. Quick operational notes from the partner ops side:

- Eligibility: Atlas needs a current SOC 2 report or an attestation plan on the registration. If you don't have SOC 2, we'll need the standard security questionnaire completed (I can send).
- Listing type: For single-tenant we map to Dedicated + Private listing. AWS may request a support letter; we can provide Redwood's compliance summary.
- Sales motion: to maximize co-sell coverage, please share two reference use cases + expected monthly spend so we can size the ACE pathway.

I will open the Marketplace intake in our internal tooling and attach our checklist. Karthik — can you propose two 30-min slots for a network scoping call (we need KMS config and Egress rules)?
